messages:
maya (CS): Hey team — Lia from SolaraPay just bumped the bespoke SIG form and flagged two blocking asks: they need proof of KMS/HSM custody (attestation or export steps) and a sample of audit logs showing retention/rotation policy. Due EOD Fri. Can we triage?
lia (Customer): hi! we need a clear export playbook and a log sample that shows key rotation events + user access entries. legal wants dates and anchors. thanks.
ehsan (SE): assigning — do we have an existing playbook for keystore export from customer-managed HSMs? if private deployment: we usually provide an "evidence package" template.
jordan (Security): For attestation we can provide signed HSM MFG attestation + KMS key metadata. Need to confirm whether SolaraPay wants a live export or just the attestation + audit logs. Live export requires coordination and a support window.
maya (CS): Lia, which do you need? attestation only or full export? Customer said "evidence that keys are not exportable and rotation is logged" — might be attestation + log sample is fine.
lia (Customer): attestation + logs is preferred. export would be difficult on their side. they asked for log lines with rotation events and any 401 spikes around rotation windows.
sam (Eng-runtime): I can pull app-level auth audit logs and rotation audit events. Quick question: which time window? last 12 months? last 90 days?
lia (Customer): last 12 months if possible, but at minimum last 90 days. legal prefers a 12mo view.
ejhan (SE): (typo?) I mean ehsan — for HSM attestation, we have vendor-signed certs stored in /artifacts/hsm-attestations. I'll stage the latest one and redact PII.
jordan (Security): Also need to include a short explanation of our retention policy: where logs live, retention length per log type, and the chain-of-custody for exports. Keep it high-level for sig, no raw secrets.
sam (Eng-runtime): grabbing sample logs now. attaching a redacted snippet below.

deploy-bot: deployment "keystore-audit-snapshot" started by sam at 2024-11-02T14:12:03Z

sam (Eng-runtime): ```
2024-10-01T03:04:22Z INFO key_rotation key_id=proj-3f2 rotation_initiated_by=auto-schedule user_id=- system=keystore
2024-10-01T03:04:25Z INFO key_rotation key_id=proj-3f2 rotation_completed status=success duration_ms=318
2024-10-01T03:05:02Z WARN auth token=redacted user_id=lia-app endpoint=/v1/generate status=401 reason=expired_token
```

sam (Eng-runtime): those are redacted. I also saw a brief auth 401 spike during rotation windows (~2-3m) where cached tokens were invalidated.
jordan (Security): good. can we quantify token failures during rotation windows? customer asked for impact metrics.
sam (Eng-runtime): I can run a query: `SELECT count(*) FROM auth_logs WHERE status=401 AND timestamp BETWEEN "2024-10-01T03:00:00Z" AND "2024-10-01T03:10:00Z"` — will paste results.
ehsan (SE): If we provide the attestation + those log samples and a short step-by-step playbook on how rotation works and why the spike happens (cache invalidation -> KV mismatch) that should satisfy most SIG reviewers.
maya (CS): Lia, we'll deliver: 1) vendor-signed HSM attestation (redacted), 2) redacted audit log sample covering rotation + auth spikes, 3) short playbook doc describing rotation process, retention windows, and export/custody controls, 4) a confirmation from finance if any billing anomalies observed during rotations. ETA: tomorrow morning. OK? :thumbsup:
lia (Customer): sounds good, thanks. please mark anything with timestamps. legal prefers timezone aware ISO.
finance-bot: flagged possible billing reconciliation item: customer reported a small spike on 2024-10-01 billing window. tagging @maya for follow-up.
maya (CS): noted, finance will reconcile. @finance-bot can you add a brief note describing whether token retries produced extra billable calls?
finance-bot: will investigate and report back by EOD.
jordan (Security): one more: for SIG we often include a bullet that the keystore private keys are HSM-protected and non-exportable; include the FIPS level and vendor name in the attestation doc. I'll prep the blurb.
ehsan (SE): prepping the playbook steps now. rough draft: 1) rotation trigger schedule 2) staging KV cache flush sequence 3) service-level retry semantics 4) evidence collection commands (logs + attestation path). I'll paste commands: ```
# collect rotation events
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example.com/internal/audit?from=2024-10-01T00:00:00Z&to=2024-10-02T00:00:00Z&filter=key_rotation" > rotation.json
# collect auth failures
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.example.com/internal/audit?filter=status:401&from=..." > auth_401.json
```

sam (Eng-runtime): pasted the query results: `auth_401_count=42` for that 10m window (baseline was ~3/minute). I'll include a short note that retries and token refreshes resolved 99% within 30s.
maya (CS): perfect. I'll assemble the package and share a secure link. Lia, expect a signed zip with README and redacted logs tomorrow AM.
lia (Customer): appreciate it. can you include a simple statement confirming no key material was shared? legal specifically asked for that sentence.
jordan (Security): yes — we'll include: "No private key material was shared; attestation certifies non-exportability per vendor standard."
maya (CS): thanks everyone — will update thread when upload is ready.
lia (Customer): :thumbsup:
